# Bosveld Draughting Service

> Bosveld Draughting Service is a house plan and draughting service run by Johan Pretorius, a draughtsman with 45 years of experience, serving Lephalale and Thabazimbi in Limpopo, South Africa.

## About

Bosveld Draughting Service is Johan Pretorius, a draughtsman (not a registered architect) with 45 years of hands-on experience drawing house plans and building drawings in the Bosveld region of Limpopo, South Africa. The business is built on deep local knowledge of Lephalale and Thabazimbi — the municipal processes, the climate, and local building conventions.

## Services

- House plans: custom residential house plans from first sketch to final drawing set
- Commercial property drawings: plans for shops, offices, and other commercial buildings
- Renovations and additions: extending, altering, or reworking existing homes and buildings
- Municipal submission drawings: plans prepared and formatted for local council/municipal approval
- Site plans: accurate site layouts for building applications, boundaries, and planning

## Area served

Lephalale, Thabazimbi, and the surrounding areas in Limpopo, South Africa.

Pricing varies by project size and complexity. Bosveld Draughting Service quotes each project individually — contact via WhatsApp or the quote form on the website for a free, no-obligation quote.
